```{r}
# load DCA two

```

```{r}
# infer mean values for missing data in dca_y2
dca_y2 <- infer_mean_for_nan(dca_y2)
```

```{r}
# set Sample.ID as row names and remove from columns
rownames(dca_y2) <- dca_y2$Sample.ID
dca_y2$Sample.ID <- NULL
dca_y2$storage_condition <- "DCA"
```

```{r}
# load CA two
ca_y2 <- load_data(file.path(DATA_DIR, "CA_Year2.csv"))
rownames(ca_y2) <- ca_y2$Sample.ID
ca_y2$Sample.ID <- NULL
ca_y2$storage_condition <- "CA"
```

```{r}
# merge DCA and CA data for Year 2
combined_y2 <- rbind(dca_y2, ca_y2)
```

```{r}
# remove week 0 from combined as these are duplicates
combined_y2 <- combined_y2[combined_y2$Storage.Week != 0, ]
```

```{r}
table(combined_y2$storage_condition, combined_y2$Storage.Week)
```

```{r}
weeks <- c(5, 11, 17, 23, 29)
combined_y2$Storage.Week <- factor(
  combined_y2$Storage.Week,
  levels = weeks, # numeric vector, not a single string
)

# order by Storage.Week
combined_y2 <- combined_y2[order(combined_y2$Storage.Week), ]
```

```{r}
# exclude Storage.Week, Ripening.Stage, and storage_condition from features
features <- combined_y2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-Storage.Week, -Ripening.Stage, -storage_condition)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

vars <- names(features)
n0 <- 12
B <- 500

# 1) one replicate -> 6x36 matrix
make_mat <- function(dat, treatment, weeks, vars, n0) {
  mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(weeks, function(w) {
    df_w <- dat %>%
      filter(storage_condition == treatment, Storage.Week == w) %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(vars))

    idx <- sample.int(nrow(df_w), size = n0, replace = TRUE)
    colMeans(df_w[idx, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  rownames(mat) <- weeks
  colnames(mat) <- vars
  mat
}

# 2) 6x36 matrix -> named numeric vector length 792
mat_to_catch22 <- function(mat) {
  val_slot_global <- NULL

  feat_vec <- unlist(lapply(colnames(mat), function(v) {
    f <- catch22_all(mat[, v])

    if (is.null(val_slot_global)) {
      val_slot_global <<- setdiff(names(f), "names")
      stopifnot(length(val_slot_global) == 1)
    }

    vals <- f[[val_slot_global]]
    names(vals) <- paste0(v, "__", f$names)
    vals
  }), use.names = TRUE)

  feat_vec
}

# 3) Generate feature rows directly (no storing mats)
make_feature_row <- function(dat, treatment, weeks, vars, n0) {
  mat <- make_mat(dat, treatment, weeks, vars, n0)
  mat_to_catch22(mat)
}

# CA features (500 x 792)
X_CA <- do.call(rbind, replicate(B, make_feature_row(combined_y2, "CA", weeks, vars, n0), simplify = FALSE))
# DCA features (500 x 792)
X_DCA <- do.call(rbind, replicate(B, make_feature_row(combined_y2, "DCA", weeks, vars, n0), simplify = FALSE))

X <- rbind(X_CA, X_DCA)
X <- as.data.frame(X)

# Add label
X$storage_condition <- factor(c(rep("CA", B), rep("DCA", B)), levels = c("CA", "DCA"))

# sanity checks
dim(X) # should be 1000 x (792 + 1)
sum(is.na(X)) # ideally 0
sum(!is.finite(as.matrix(X[, -ncol(X)]))) # ideally 0
head(X[, c(1, 2, 3, ncol(X))])
```

```{r}
# Remove constant (and optionally near-zero variance) predictors using TRAIN only,
# then center/scale, then fit RF with caret.

set.seed(42)

# 1) Split
train_idx <- createDataPartition(X$storage_condition, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
trainSet <- X[train_idx, ]
testSet <- X[-train_idx, ]

trainCl <- trainSet$storage_condition
testCl <- testSet$storage_condition

trainX <- trainSet %>% dplyr::select(-storage_condition)
testX <- testSet %>% dplyr::select(-storage_condition)

# 2) Center/scale using TRAIN only
pp <- preProcess(trainX, method = c("center", "scale"))
trainX_sc <- predict(pp, trainX)
testX_sc <- predict(pp, testX)

train_sc <- data.frame(trainX_sc, storage_condition = trainCl)
test_sc <- data.frame(testX_sc, storage_condition = testCl)

# 3) Fit RF (ranger) + predict
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)

rf_fit <- train(
  storage_condition ~ .,
  data = train_sc,
  method = "ranger",
  trControl = ctrl,
  importance = "impurity"
)

pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_sc)

# 4) Evaluate
CrossTable(testCl, pred, prop.chisq = FALSE, prop.t = FALSE, prop.c = FALSE, prop.r = FALSE)
confusionMatrix(pred, testCl, positive = "DCA")

# sanity: how many predictors kept?
c(n_before = ncol(trainX), n_after = ncol(trainX))
```
